banner.reduced: Reduced mode: the map only uncovers while the app is open. Enable background to explore as you walk.
banner.denied: Location is off. Turn it on so your walk reveals the map.
banner.expoGo: Reduced mode: in Expo Go the map only uncovers while the app is open. Background needs a development build.
banner.notificationsDenied: Alerts unavailable: notifications are denied. Enable them in Settings.
banner.alertsExpoGo: Alerts are on. They cannot be watched inside Expo Go, which runs nothing in the background: this needs a native build.
banner.alertsNeedAlways: Alerts are on. Watching them needs the Always location permission.

notifications.foregroundBody: Walking keeps uncovering new territory, even in the background.
notifications.nearbyBody: You're steps away from an uncollected spot.

poi.collectHint: Walk up to it to collect. Collecting is out of scope for this use case.

locating.title: Finding you
locating.body: A few more seconds while GPS locks on.
locating.unavailableBody: Opening the map anyway. It will settle as soon as the signal returns.
